request.style: English, male solo voice, dignified and steady, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, cymbals, timpani, reverent and powerful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Be strong in the Lord and his might
Put on the full armor of God
So you can stand against the devil
And his scheming and wiles

[Chorus]
Our struggle is not against flesh and blood
But against rulers and authorities
Cosmic powers of this darkness
Forces of evil in heavenly realms

[Verse]
Therefore take up the full armor of God
So you may hold your ground
On the evil day and stand firm
Having done everything

[Chorus]
Our struggle is not against flesh and blood
But against rulers and authorities
Cosmic powers of this darkness
Forces of evil in heavenly realms

[Bridge]
Stand firm with the belt of truth
Buckled around your waist
Righteousness as your breastplate
Protecting your heart

[Chorus]
Our struggle is not against flesh and blood
But against rulers and authorities
Cosmic powers of this darkness
Forces of evil in heavenly realms

[Outro]
So stand firm
In the light
